summary: Review of PR #25 (Owner directive, merged by the Owner as a proposal): a lightweight purpose and common-sense check before a tool operation. Accepted with four amendments; carried into v0.13 as execution_model.entry_check and one invariant.
rationale: The check is USG's function-first thesis applied to a single object or operation. v0.12 covers the purpose of a new structure (S00) and the entry stage (Core rule) but not the moment before an operation inside a partly resolved structure. Amendments keep it within existing authority rules: purpose read from context is a plausibility reading, not a human decision; contradictions are reported, not silently fixed; escalation triggers are named; no new stage and no Standards requirement.
